Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a specialized SILAC approach to distinguish newly synthesized proteins (heavy) from the pre-existing extracellular matrix background (light) in a 3D lung slice model. While MaxQuant LFQ settings were used, the core labeling strategy is SILAC.

scope: Frozen samples were transferred to 250 µL of 8 M urea, 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate in liquid chromatography grade H2O and homogenized using an Omni Tissue Homogenizer equipped with hard tissue tips
The homogenate was centrifuged at 14000 × g for 15 min and the protein concentration of the supernatant was estimated using a Nanodrop 2000.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on homogenized samples consisting of AEC2 cells cultured in decellularized lung slices (DLS). While the study focuses on the matrisome (extracellular matrix), the sample preparation describes a bulk homogenization of the frozen tissue/cell samples followed by centrifugation to obtain a protein supernatant, which corresponds to a whole cell/tissue lysate approach rather than a specific subcellular fractionation or affinity purification of a protein complex.
